lines.en: label norikodorm25:
scene norikorestaurant1
I knock on Noriko’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Noriko 的门，等着她来应门。

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant2
: Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师？

lines.en: But, to my surprise, she comes right on out and I don’t even have time to tell you about what I planned on doing here tonight.
lines.zh: 但出乎我意料的是，她直接就出来了，我甚至还没来得及交代我今晚本来打算在这儿做什么。

lines.en: : What’s up? What brings you over to my neck of the woods?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？什么风把你吹到我这一亩三分地来了？

lines.en: : A better question is why were you so prepared to leave your room the moment I knocked?
lines.zh: : 更好的问题是，为什么我一敲门你就已经准备好要出门了？

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant3
: Would you believe me if I said I was just waiting around for you to show up?
lines.zh: : 如果我说我一直在等你出现，你会信吗？

lines.en: : Yes, actually. You have proven to be rather...dog-like in the past.
lines.zh: : 会，真的。你过去已经证明自己相当……像狗。

lines.en: : Bend me over and I’ll show you just how dog-like I really am.
lines.zh: : 把我按弯下去，我就让你看看我到底有多像狗。

lines.en: : I mean what? Who said that? Not me. I’m Noriko. A human girl.
lines.zh: : 我是说，什么？谁说的？不是我。我是 Noriko。一个人类女孩。

lines.en: : Well then, irrefutably human girl, what are you doing tonight?
lines.zh: : 那么，不容置疑的人类女孩，你今晚打算做什么？

lines.en: : Well, I {i}was{/i} going to go for a walk...
lines.zh: : 嗯，我{i}本来{/i}打算去散步的……

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant4
: But {i}now{/i} I am going to change that plan entirely and invite you out to dinner!
lines.zh: : 但{i}现在{/i}我要把计划彻底改掉，邀请你出去吃晚饭！

lines.en: : You’re inviting {i}me{/i} out to dinner? How chivalrous.
lines.zh: : 你要请{i}我{/i}吃晚饭？真有骑士风度。

lines.en: : Chivalry is dead! Both sexes are on equal footing now and it’s okay for girls to ask guys out because relationships require equal effort on both ends and males should not be obligated to always strike first!
lines.zh: : 骑士精神早就死啦！现在两性平起平坐，女生约男生完全没问题，因为感情需要双方付出同等的努力，男生没有义务永远先开口！

lines.en: : Also, I am hungry and there’s something I want to talk to you about!
lines.zh: : 而且我饿了，还有件事想跟你谈！

lines.en: : Does it involve smashing the patriarchy?
lines.zh: : 是要打碎父权制吗？

lines.en: : Is the patriarchy your penis?
lines.zh: : 父权制是你的阴茎吗？

lines.en: : In an extremely roundabout way...kind of?
lines.zh: : 从某种极其迂回的角度来说……算是吧？

lines.en: : Then...also kind of!
lines.zh: : 那……也算！

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant5
: To be completely honest, it really only {i}slightly{/i} involves your penis, but only as like a...concept.
lines.zh: : 说实话，其实只跟你的阴茎沾了{i}一点点{/i}边，而且只是作为一个……概念。

lines.en: : You are inviting me out to dinner to discuss the concept of my penis?
lines.zh: : 你请我吃晚饭是为了讨论我阴茎的概念？

lines.en: : In an extremely roundabout way...kind of?
lines.zh: : 从某种极其迂回的角度来说……算是吧？

lines.en: : Well, thankfully, that is one of a few topics I am incredibly well versed in. I hereby accept your invitation.
lines.zh: : 谢天谢地，这恰好是我极其精通的少数几个话题之一。我在此接受你的邀请。

lines.en: : Now, where are we going?
lines.zh: : 那么，我们去哪儿？

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant6
: Soooo...you know that restaurant you went to with Nee-chan shortly after I found you and the hands on the clock of our romantic aptitude started ticking once more?
lines.zh: : 那、那个……你知道我找到你之后不久、我和你之间那台浪漫资质时钟的指针重新开始走动时，你和姐姐去的那家餐厅吗？

lines.en: : The hands of...what? Wait, are you talking about the place with the sausage fest?
lines.zh: : 什么的指针？等等，你说的是那个香肠大会的地方吗？

lines.en: : No, no. I can’t eat sausage, remember? Vegetarian.
lines.zh: : 不不。我不能吃香肠，记得吗？素食主义者。

lines.en: : That is going to make the penis discussion very depressing for both of us.
lines.zh: : 那这场阴茎讨论对我们两个来说都会非常扫兴。

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant7
: I’m talking about the fancier one. Where she opened up about her past and how she dealt with being apart from you and...all that stuff.
lines.zh: : 我说的是更讲究的那家。她在那里敞开了自己的过去，讲了她怎么熬过和你分开的日子……还有那些事。

lines.en: : You sure know a lot of what Niki and I talk about despite never really being there for any of it.
lines.zh: : 你根本没在场，却知道这么多 Niki 和我聊过的事。

lines.en: : Well, it’s not like she really has anyone {i}else{/i} to talk to about...anything.
lines.zh: : 嗯，反正她也没有{i}别的{/i}什么人可以聊……任何事。

lines.en: : And I guess she’s still just kind of used to talking to me about all you-related stuff since that’s how things were back in the old days too.
lines.zh: : 而且我猜她大概还是习惯跟我聊所有和你有关的事，毕竟从前我们之间就是这样。

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant8
: But now it’s my turn!
lines.zh: : 但现在轮到我了！

lines.en: : It’s not fair that {i}she{/i} got to have you all to herself in some dimly lit, four star sex trap!
lines.zh: : 不公平，{i}她{/i}居然能在这家灯光昏暗的四星级性爱陷阱里独占你！

lines.en: : The time has come for you to hear my side of the story!
lines.zh: : 是时候让你听听我的版本了！

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant9
: And...for me to maybe feel like I’m not just chasing after a ghost again...
lines.zh: : 还有……让我能稍微觉得，自己不是在又一次追着一个幽灵跑……

lines.en: scene black
I take a moment to ponder over what Noriko meant by that, and confirm to myself that it’s likely about that “disappearing act” I put on a while back.
lines.zh: 我花了一会儿琢磨 Noriko 这话是什么意思，并向自己确认：大概是指我前阵子演的那出“人间蒸发”。

lines.en: I don’t know how many times she needs me to remind her that I don’t know anything about what happened back then, but...
lines.zh: 我不知道还得提醒她多少次，我对那时发生的事一无所知，不过……

lines.en: I guess it wouldn’t be harmful to learn more about how things were for her when hearing Niki’s side didn’t cause me to malfunction in any way.
lines.zh: 既然听了 Niki 的版本也没让我出什么故障，多了解一点她当时的处境，大概也没什么坏处。

lines.en: Even now that I’m starting to become a little more hesitant to get filled in on details of the past (Thanks, Maya), I’m almost positive that it’s only details about {i}me{/i} that have the chance of frying my brain.
lines.zh: 即便{i}我{/i}现在开始有点不太愿意被人补上过去的细节了（谢了，Maya），我也几乎可以肯定，只有关于我的细节才有可能把我的脑子烧坏。

lines.en: And, if Noriko wants me to know about {i}her{/i}, after all, it’s not like I can avoid this forever.
lines.zh: 再说，如果 Noriko 想让我了解{i}她{/i}，反正我也不可能永远躲着这件事。

lines.en: Every single detail I can learn and memorize about her brings me one step closer to getting her shirt off again.
lines.zh: 我能学到并记住的关于她的每一个细节，都让我离再把她的上衣脱掉更近一步。

lines.en: And that’s why I’m here, after all.
lines.zh: 毕竟，我来这儿就是为了这个。

lines.en: That’s...
lines.zh: 那是……

lines.en: We {b}WALK{/b} to the {b}RESTAURANT.{/b}
lines.zh: 我们{b}步行{/b}前往{b}餐厅{/b}。

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant10
: Wow...I knew this place would be kinda nice based on what she said, but...this is a little fancier than I was expecting.
lines.zh: : 哇……听她说我就知道这地方会挺不错，但……这比我预想的还要讲究一些。

lines.en: : I would have worn my {i}nice{/i} clothes if I had known it was going to be a place like this.
lines.zh: : 早知道是这种地方，我就穿我那套{i}像样{/i}的衣服来了。

lines.en: : You? Nice clothes? Impossible.
lines.zh: : 你？像样的衣服？不可能。

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant11
: Hey. Don’t go forgetting that I was always the one who wanted to dress up when we were younger. It was Nee-chan who was always trying to stay in sweatpants for as long as physically possible.
lines.zh: : 嘿。别忘了，我们小时候一直都是我最想打扮。是姐姐总想尽可能久地赖在运动裤里。

lines.en: : Did most of that desire to dress up come from an overwhelming need to impress you? Of course. But even though I rarely do it anymore, I still like feeling pretty from time to time.
lines.zh: : 这种想打扮的欲望，大部分当然来自想让你对我刮目相看的强烈需求。但即便我现在很少这么做了，我还是喜欢偶尔觉得自己漂亮。

lines.en: : Well you certainly pulled off that dress for your parents’ restaurant, so I can see it.
lines.zh: : 你穿给你爸妈餐厅的那条裙子确实很成功，所以我看得出来。

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant12
: Do you think they have falafel here?
lines.zh: : 你觉得这儿会有炸豆丸子吗？

lines.en: : Probably not, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 大概没有，Noriko。

lines.en: : They should have falafel here. I’m going to speak to the manager.
lines.zh: : 他们这儿该有炸豆丸子的。我要去找经理谈谈。

lines.en: : Please don’t. The less attention I have for being on a date with a [teenage]girl, the better.
lines.zh: : 求你别。我带着一个[teenage]女孩约会，越少引人注目越好。

lines.en: : Friend!
lines.zh: : 朋友！

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant13
: You have found yet another [young_girl] to waste away your days with! How exciting!
lines.zh: : 你又找了一个[young_girl]来虚度你的日子！多让人兴奋啊！

lines.en: : And this one looks just like the cotton candy girl! But spikier and less confident!
lines.zh: : 而这个长得就像那个棉花糖女孩！只是更扎人、也更没自信！

lines.en: : Kaori, how are you balancing those wine glasses on a plate you’re holding sideways?
lines.zh: : Kaori，你是怎么把那些酒杯稳在一个你横着端的盘子上的？

lines.en: : It is not sideways! That is just what you imagine it to be!
lines.zh: : 那不是横着！那只是你想象出来的！

lines.en: : The plate is a plate! And the glass tubes of fermented grape blood stand as tall as trees!
lines.zh: : 盘子就是盘子！那些发酵的葡萄血做的玻璃管像树一样挺立！

lines.en: : Drink them and you shall become them! Grapes!
lines.zh: : 喝下它们，你就会变成它们！葡萄！

lines.en: : Okay, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 好吧，Kaori。

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant14
: Are you in trouble, {i}smaller{/i} cotton candy human?
lines.zh: : 你遇到麻烦了吗，{i}小一号{/i}的棉花糖人类？

lines.en: : I’m good! I was actually just wondering if you had falafel here, though. Or like...maybe portobello burgers or something?
lines.zh: : 我没事！不过我其实只是想知道你们这儿有没有炸豆丸子。或者……也许波特贝勒菇汉堡之类的？

lines.en: : Noriko, they don’t-
lines.zh: : Noriko，他们没有——

lines.en: : Spiced bean circles and cruelty free fungus burgers for the pink one! Thank you for your contribution to the animal kingdom!
lines.zh: : 给粉色那位上香料豆子圆饼和无残忍菌菇汉堡！感谢你对动物王国的贡献！

lines.en: : Okay, then. I guess they do have...whatever you ordered after all.
lines.zh: : 好吧。看来他们确实有……你点的那些东西。

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant15
: Has your tongue signaled to your brain what it wants to taste yet, Friend?
lines.zh: : 你的舌头已经向大脑发出它想尝什么的信号了吗，朋友？

lines.en: : I’ll have-
lines.zh: : 我要——

lines.en: : I understand! I will get that for you sooner than you can say “loxosceles reclusa!”
lines.zh: : 我明白了！我会比你说出“loxosceles reclusa”还快地把它们端上来！

lines.en: : Loxosceles reclusa.
lines.zh: : Loxosceles reclusa.

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant16
: Ah! Too quick! Stop doing the words!
lines.zh: : 啊！太快了！别再说那些词了！

lines.en: : Loxosceles reclusa.
lines.zh: : Loxosceles reclusa.

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant17
: MY POWER WANES! I GROW WEAKER WITH EACH UTTERANCE!
lines.zh: : 我的力量在衰退！每吐出一个字我就更虚弱一分！

lines.en: : GOODBYE FRIENDBURGER. ENJOY DEVOURING THE HAIR OF YET ANOTHER FEMALE.
lines.zh: : 再见了朋友汉堡。愿你享用又一位雌性的毛发时愉快。

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant18
: Are you really going to eat my hair, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师，你真的要吃我的头发吗？

lines.en: : What? No.
lines.zh: : 什么？不要。

lines.en: : Because you can if you want. I don’t mind.
lines.zh: : 因为你想的话可以啊。我不介意。

lines.en: : You definitely should mind. That’s not a normal thing people do.
lines.zh: : 你当然该介意。正常人不会做这种事。

lines.en: : No. But I was watching My Strange Addiction with Kirin the other day and there was this one guy who had sex with those giant blow up pool animals.
lines.zh: : 不会。但我前两天和 Kirin 一起看了《我的怪癖瘾》，里面有个男人跟那些巨大的充气泳池动物做爱。

lines.en: : All things considered, I think wanting to eat my hair is pretty normal by comparison. Besides, it grows back pretty quickly anyway.
lines.zh: : 总的来说，相比之下我觉得想吃我的头发还挺正常的。再说头发长得也挺快的。

lines.en: : I think it’s the color. It sounds easier for pale skin to produce pink hair than it would be to produce like black or...brown or whatever.
lines.zh: : 我觉得是颜色的关系。听起来苍白的皮肤长出粉色头发，比长出黑色或者……棕色什么的要容易。

lines.en: : Why are you still talking about this?
lines.zh: : 你为什么还在聊这个？

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant19
: Becaaaaaaaaause...I’m nervous?
lines.zh: : 因、为、啊……因为我紧张？

lines.en: : Obviously we’ve been hanging out a lot lately and...it’s starting to really set in that you’re {i}back{/i}...but this is the first like, {i}real{/i} date we’ve been on.
lines.zh: : 显然我们最近经常见面，而且……你{i}回来{/i}的事实也开始真的落进我心里了，但这是我们第一次{i}真正{/i}意义上的约会。

lines.en: : I was doing okay until you called it that a few minutes ago, but ever since then I’ve just been like, “Holy shit. I’m on a date with Sensei. It’s finally happening.”
lines.zh: : 几分钟前你叫它“约会”之前我状态还行，可从那之后我就一直在想，“我操。我在和老师约会。这真的发生了。”

lines.en: : So obviously, the best course of action is to start a conversation about eating hair in order to make sure the date is a success.
lines.zh: : 所以显然，为了确保这场约会成功，最好的办法就是开启一个关于吃头发的话题。

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant20
: Obviously. I mean, it’s better than bringing up something like politics or our stances on whether or not circumcision is cruel.
lines.zh: : 显然。我是说，总比聊政治或者我们对割礼是否残忍的立场要好。

lines.en: : If that’s your idea of a segue into the “concept of my penis,” I would like to take this moment to commend you for near flawless execution.
lines.zh: : 如果这是你切入“我阴茎的概念”的方式，我想借此机会表扬你近乎完美的执行。

lines.en: : I’m just trying to stop shaking, to be totally honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我只是想让自己别再发抖。

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant21
: I learned this trick where if you stop crossing your arms and legs and just kinda sit up straight and regulate your breathing, it helps with nervousness.
lines.zh: : 我学了个窍门，就是别再交叉双臂双腿，干脆坐直、调整呼吸，这样对紧张有帮助。

lines.en: : I figure if I just keep this up for the next three hours or so, I’ll finally be able to come out and ask you what I’ve been meaning to ask you since the beach.
lines.zh: : 我想，只要就这么坚持上三个小时左右，我总算能开口问你从海边那次之后一直想问的事。

lines.en: : I highly doubt we’re going to be here for that long, so why don’t you just go ahead and start filling me in on your super secret backstory until then?
lines.zh: : 我高度怀疑我们不会在这儿待那么久，所以不如你趁现在就开始跟我讲讲你那超级机密的往事？

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant22
: Hah...
: You won’t be upset if there’s actually minimal penis in the story, would you? I know I lured you over here with promise of that being a big thing, but it’s really not.
lines.zh: : 如果故事里阴茎的戏份其实很少，你不会生气吧？我知道我是用那玩意儿当大卖点把你骗来的，但其实不是那么回事。

lines.en: : It definitely is.
lines.zh: : 绝对是。

lines.en: : No, it’s-
scene norikorestaurant23
: Oh, like actual size.
lines.zh: : 哦，你是说实际尺寸。

lines.en: : Yeah. In that regard, it is {i}definitely{/i} a big thing.
lines.zh: : 对。就这点而言，它{i}绝对{/i}是个大东西。

lines.en: : I just mean that the whole...sexually explorative yet still nervous Noriko isn’t as important as the...frantic lost sheep Noriko of the past.
lines.zh: : 我只是说，那个……性方面勇于探索却又依然紧张的 Noriko，没有过去那个……慌乱的迷途羔羊 Noriko 来得重要。

lines.en: : I’m sure Niki told you about how she went through that whole period of depression and reinvention stuff after you left, right?
lines.zh: : Niki 应该跟你说过，你走了之后她经历了整整一段抑郁和重塑自我的时期，对吧？

lines.en: : Right. And it got significantly darker than I ever expected it to.
lines.zh: : 对。而且那比我想象的要黑暗得多。

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant22
: What happened with me really wasn’t all that {i}dark{/i} by comparison.
lines.zh: : 相比之下，我身上发生的事真没那么{i}黑暗{/i}。

lines.en: : If anything, it was probably one of the most active parts of my life.
lines.zh: : 倒不如说，那大概是我人生中最活跃的时期之一。

lines.en: : You see, I wasn’t like Nee-chan in the fact that you weren’t completely opposed to seeing me anymore like you were with her.
lines.zh: : 你看，我和姐姐不同，你并没有像对她那样彻底拒绝再见我。

lines.en: : And once you let me back into your life, I was ecstatic.
lines.zh: : 而一旦你让我重新回到你的生活里，我就欣喜若狂。

lines.en: : I saw an opportunity to try and pull you back, little by little, while getting closer to you at the same time and showing you that I was...smart.
lines.zh: : 我看到了一个机会，可以一点一点把你拉回来，同时离你更近，让你看到我很……聪明。

lines.en: : Smart and fun and lovable. Like a little sister cross bred with what I imagined your dream girl would be. And for a while, I felt like we really {i}were{/i} in a good place.
lines.zh: : 聪明、有趣又可爱。像个小妹妹，再杂交上我想象中你的梦中情人。有一阵子，我真的觉得我们{i}处在{/i}很好的位置上。

lines.en: : So good that part of me wanted to forget you and Nee-chan were ever in love in the first place...and that you were like my secret prince or something along those lines.
lines.zh: : 好到我心里有一部分希望干脆忘掉你和姐姐曾经相恋这件事……希望你就是我的秘密王子之类的。

lines.en: : Little by little, your name stopped coming up back at home. Not just because Nee-chan couldn’t see you anymore, but because I wanted to keep you all to myself.
lines.zh: : 一点一点地，你的名字在家里出现的次数越来越少。不只是因为姐姐不能再见你，更因为我想把你据为己有。

lines.en: : So I’d wake up on the weekends, make myself look as pretty as I could, and wait patiently by the stairs for my parents to drive me over to that grody, crumbling building where you taught me so many things.
lines.zh: : 所以每到周末我都会起床，把自己打扮得尽可能漂亮，然后耐心地在楼梯边等着爸妈开车送我去那栋破旧、行将坍塌的楼——你在那里教会了我那么多东西。

lines.en: : It was like a second home. A castle, even. A place for my prince and me to be alone.
lines.zh: : 那就像第二个家。甚至像一座城堡。一个只属于我和我的王子的地方。

lines.en: : And even if it wasn’t the most desirable looking building in all of Kumon-mi, I didn’t care. Because for a few hours every week, it was the most beautiful place in the whole wide world.
lines.zh: : 哪怕它不是整个 Kumon-mi 最体面的建筑，我也不在乎。因为每周有那么几个小时，它是全世界最美的地方。

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant24
: Lots of girls came and went over that short period of time- probably due to a mix of exactly what you were teaching and where you were teaching it.
lines.zh: : 那短短一段时间里有好多女孩来了又走——大概是因为你教的东西和教的地方凑在一起的效果。

lines.en: : And I would have been happy if things stayed that way forever.
lines.zh: : 如果一切能永远那样下去，我就会很幸福。

lines.en: : I would have waited until you got an actual teaching job and then enrolled at whatever[school] hired you, no matter how far away it was.
lines.zh: : 我本来会一直等到你真正当上老师，然后去任何雇了你的[school]上学，不管它有多远。

lines.en: : But, of course, a nasty streak of poor luck landed somebody else in that same exact castle of ours.
lines.zh: : 但当然，一连串恶心的霉运把另一个人送进了我们那同一座城堡。

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant25
: I liked Maya. I really did.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢 Maya。真的喜欢。

lines.en: : I thought she was cool and...really, {i}really{/i} mature for her age.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她很酷，而且……以她的年纪来说非常、{i}非常{/i}成熟。

lines.en: : She reminded me a lot of you.
lines.zh: : 她让我想起你很多地方。

lines.en: : And I guess she reminded {i}you{/i} of you too, since you took to her immediately.
lines.zh: : 而我猜她也让想起了你{i}自己{/i}，所以你立刻就对她上心了。

lines.en: : Soon enough, the castle for two turned into a castle for three.
lines.zh: : 没过多久，两个人的城堡变成了三个人的城堡。

lines.en: : But every time I tried to move closer, the same way I’d been doing since I met you, it would be like you’d just move even further away in response.
lines.zh: : 但每次我试着靠近一点，用我从认识你起就一直在用的方式，你就好像会相应地退得更远。

lines.en: : And then one day...you moved further away than I ever expected you to.
lines.zh: : 然后有一天……你退得比我预想的还要远。

lines.en: : It came out of nowhere and, I won’t lie, I was crushed.
lines.zh: : 那来得毫无征兆，说实话，我崩溃了。

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant24
: But unlike Nee-chan, who was content wallowing in self-pity forever, I was going to do something about it.
lines.zh: : 但和姐姐不同——她乐意永远沉浸在自怜里——我打算做点什么。

lines.en: : I took it upon myself to go out and find you because I didn’t think you’d ever leave if you really had a choice.
lines.zh: : 我主动出去找你，因为我觉得如果你真的有得选，你绝不会离开。

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant26
: I looked everywhere. Or at least as many places a girl with access to only public transportation and a capped data plan on her phone could look.
lines.zh: : 我找遍了所有地方。或者说，找遍了一个只能坐公共交通、手机流量还有上限的女孩能找的所有地方。

lines.en: : But Kumon-mi’s a big fucking place, Sensei. And even bigger when you have no idea where you’re going.
lines.zh: : 但 Kumon-mi 是个大得要命的地方啊，老师。在你完全不知道自己该往哪儿去的时候，它还要更大。

lines.en: scene norikorestaurant26
: But then...I fucking found you.
lines.zh: : 可后来……我他妈找到了你。

lines.zh: : 在老城区，我从公交车的窗户里，用余光瞥见你[[redacted]和[[redacted]。

lines.zh: : 我求司机停车，好让我下去追你，搂住你，求你回家。
